about: The object's moves between its four states, one act at a time, on a cell resting on one bound.
CONFLICT is reached two ways: locally, by claims that do not meet, and by signature, by a floor required past a signed ceiling or a ceiling signed under a required floor, whatever the claims hold.
Every move into CONFLICT is dangerous; every other is a cell becoming information, being taken back, closed or reopened.

coverage.criterion: each act once, every move into CONFLICT from each state it is reached from, both ways CONFLICT is reached, and one act that moves nothing
coverage.why: a state read wrong by any act fails its case, and a CONFLICT by signature read as FORBIDDEN fails the three that reach it

why_the_others_are_not.REQUIRED→FREE: a second origin met the first
why_the_others_are_not.FREE→FORBIDDEN: a signature closed below what they hold

cases.case: a second origin that meets the first: REQUIRED → FREE
a second origin that does not meet the first: REQUIRED → CONFLICT, locally
a withdrawal of the second: FREE → REQUIRED
a signature below what they hold: FREE → FORBIDDEN
a floor required past the signed ceiling: FREE → CONFLICT, by signature
a ceiling signed under a required floor, one origin: REQUIRED → CONFLICT, by signature
a witnessed join over a signature: FORBIDDEN → FREE
a floor the claims already hold: FREE stays FREE
a signature past a floor two origins require, from FORBIDDEN: FORBIDDEN → CONFLICT, by signature
